about.title: about Us
about.trust: RONICS LLC offers the implementation of automated process control systems (APCS) of any complexity at your enterprise. Customers come to us from a wide variety of industries, energy, communications, mechanical engineering, transport and many others. Our company can carry out both a comprehensive implementation of an automated process control system at your facility, and offer the implementation of individual stages: design, development, procurement, supply of equipment, installation, commissioning, post-warranty and technical support.
about.trust_part: We help clients solve automation issues of any level of complexity. Today, RONICS LLC has both ready-made solutions for standard projects and can develop a working project for highly specialized tasks of your production. At the same time, in each case, the implemented project is developed taking into account the tasks, specifics and needs of production.

comment.text: RONICS sees its customers as lifelong partners. We know how to listen and analyze. We offer the most optimal solutions for each of our partners after thoroughly studying their requirements. We don't sell products, we provide quality solutions! It is our goal to perform any task of any complexity that may arise in all IT services. In this, the experience and knowledge of the whole team is directed to the expected result. The product of your thoughts and work is our pride. We are ready to be your only choice in providing perfect IT solutions for your company.

vertical_slider.text4: The United IT Company team puts quality above financial interests. More precisely, we work with people, not computers. The comments of our clients also confirm RONICS's responsible approach to entrusted tasks and obligations, maintaining a harmonious team work process.
